PokemonLeague_LancesRoom_Text_Intro:
Ah! I've heard about you, {PLAYER}!
I lead the ELITE FOUR.
You can call me LANCE the dragon TRAINER.

Your LEAGUE challenge ends with me, {PLAYER}!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}
